newsitem.title: GERMANY: DIHT sees German growth one pct '96, 1.5-2 pct '97.
newsitem.headline: DIHT sees German growth one pct '96, 1.5-2 pct '97.

text.p: Germany's Federation of Chambers of Commerce (DIHT), publishing a business survey, said on Tuesday it expected the economy to grow by one percent this year, and between 1.5 and two percent in 1997.

The DIHT's autumn survey of 25,000 companies shows that business leaders are less optimistic over the pace of economic recovery than the Bonn government and leading think-tanks, which are forecasting growth of 2.5 percent next year.
Recovery hopes have not yet fed through into investment and employment plans. The survey said the decline in employment would continue next year, albeit at a slower pace.
